summary: Initializes a 20-byte small entry struct: clears the DWORD at this+0x0 to 0, resets the DWORD at this+0x4 to -1, reinitializes the global path string buffer byte_5EA438 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, resets the DWORDs at this+0x8 and this+0xC to -1, clears the byte at this+0x10 to 0, and returns this. Called by NamedEntryLookupInFormatList, VehicleListBuilderFromGlobalArray and SceneListBuilderFromGlobalArray during entry setup.

local_names.linkField: DWORD at this+0x0, cleared to 0 (entry pointer/link field)
local_names.idOrTypeField: DWORD at this+0x4, reset to -1 (entry id/type field)

operations.description: Clears the DWORD link field at this+0x0 to 0.
Resets the DWORD at this+0x4 to -1 (entry id/type field).
Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438) to reinitialize the global default path string buffer as part of entry initialization.
Resets the DWORD at this+0x8 to -1.
Resets the DWORD at this+0xC to -1.
Clears the byte at this+0x10 to 0.
Returns this, the initialized entry struct.

unresolved: The exact purpose of the -1-initialized DWORDs at this+0x4/0x8/0xC and the byte at this+0x10 is not evidenced beyond reset-on-init; the struct spans only 20 bytes (0x14).
Why byte_5EA438 is reinitialized during entry init is not evidenced; StringCopyWithBufferRealloc may carry side effects beyond the string copy.
